title: Billing Desk Rule: Applying an Earned On-Time Guarantee Credit to the Contract
content:
**Rule.** Under Factory Production Orders, an earned guarantee credit is applied in full to the contract the order builds within the stated business days after the ship date, by one credit application that names the earned credit as its source; the contract records it as an on-time guarantee credit. An earned credit is applied to the contract only once. Where the credit exceeds what is owed on the contract, the excess is refunded under that contract's refund rules. A credit earned before the contract was cancelled is still applied to the cancelled contract's settlement.

The application period is the class figure for applying a credit to the contract after the ship date, in business days (Monday through Friday, excluding U.S. federal holidays), and the destination follows the class credit application rule: contract balance, then refund.

## Elements of the rule

| Element | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Amount applied | the earned credit in full |
| Destination | the window contract or door contract the order builds |
| Form | one credit application naming the earned credit as its source |
| How the contract shows it | an on-time guarantee credit |
| Number of applications per earned credit | one |
| Credit larger than the amount owed | the excess is refunded under the contract's refund rules |
| Contract cancelled after the credit was earned | the credit is still applied to the cancelled contract's settlement |

## Evidence of a prior application

Whether an earned credit has already been applied is read from the order's milestone records: a credit application naming that earned credit as its source shows that it has been applied, and a second application of the same credit is not made.

## Hypothetical cases

- An order earns a credit of 120.00 and its window contract still owes 900.00; the 120.00 is applied to the contract balance.
- An order earns a credit of 300.00 and its door contract owes 180.00; 180.00 settles the amount owed and the 120.00 excess is refunded under the door contract's refund rules.
